questions.q: Write the standard-form equation of the ellipse with foci $(0, \pm 3)$ and vertices $(0, \pm 5)$.

parts: Write the equation in standard form.
State the lengths of the major and minor axes.
Find the coordinates of the foci.

questions.q: A whispering gallery has an elliptical ceiling 40 m long and 24 m high at the center (so $a = 20$ and $b = 12$, with the major axis horizontal). Two people stand at the foci. How far apart are they, to one decimal place?
questions.answer: $c = \sqrt{400 - 144} = \sqrt{256} = 16$, so the foci are $2c = 32.0$ m apart.

questions.q: An ellipse centered at the origin has a horizontal major axis of length 12 and passes through the point $(3, 2\sqrt{3})$. Find its equation.
